articles.title: Shift from a Leader-Follower to a Leader-Leader Approach
articles.summary: This article discusses how many leaders in technical fields ascend through demonstrated engineering excellence. Their journey often involves mastering clean coding, elegant architectural design, and scalable solution development. It highlights the importance of foundational technical prowess and continuous contribution, even while leading teams. For an SSB aspirant, this underscores the value of acquiring deep domain expertise before aspiring to leadership, mirroring the need for strong operational skills in service.

articles.title: Mint Quick Edit | India’s defence must adapt to shifts in the dynamics of power projection across the Indo-Pacific
articles.summary: The Shangri-La Dialogue, a crucial defence summit, recently concluded in Singapore. Defence experts gathered to analyze the current geopolitical flux, seeking insights into future security implications. Organized by a London-based institute, the dialogue focused on understanding evolving global dynamics. This event is vital for SSB aspirants to grasp international defence strategies and major global security discussions.

articles.title: India Has Signed BrahMos Missile Deal With Vietnam, Indian Minister Says
articles.summary: India has finalized a deal to supply Vietnam with the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile system, significantly enhancing Vietnam's defence capabilities. A similar agreement with Indonesia is also nearing completion. This strategic move strengthens bilateral ties and positions India as a key defence exporter in the Indo-Pacific, promoting regional security and India's 'Make in India' initiative in defence.
